main.h3:
PROVISIONAL ALLOTMENT OF
RESIDENTIAL
COMMERCIAL
FILE
main.p:
The Management of Society is pleased to provisionally allot you a
RESIDENTIAL
COMMERCIAL
File bearing File No. , measuring Square Yards, subject to society rules and payment schedule.

div.p: This provisional allotment is subject to the following terms and conditions:

li.p: In case of a corner plot, additional charges shall be applicable as per society policy.
The allottee shall pay the remaining balance of the plot strictly in accordance with the prescribed installment schedule.

Possession of the plot shall be handed over only after receipt of 100% payment. Final adjustment in plot area, if any, shall be made according to ground situation at the time of possession, and cost shall be adjusted accordingly.
Any additional charges levied by the society for facilities or amenities such as underground electrification, if applicable, shall be payable by the allottee.

All payments and installments must be made on time. In case of default or delayed payment, the society or managing committee reserves the right to cancel the allotment as per society bye-laws, without prior notice.
In case of cancellation of membership or plot, a refund after deduction of 20% of the paid amount shall be admissible within 60 days from the date of cancellation.
The allottee shall strictly abide by the rules, regulations, and bye-laws of the society enforced from time to time.
In case of violation of society rules, excessive delay in payments, or non-compliance with terms, the plot allotment shall be liable to cancellation.

If compulsory installments required for initial allotment are not paid within the prescribed time, the plot number shall not be allocated. Allocation shall only be made after clearance of outstanding dues along with applicable surcharge or revised cost, as determined by the management.

In case of delayed payments, the allottee shall be liable to pay either an escalation charge of 2% per month for the delayed period or the revised prevailing cost of the plot at the time of payment, whichever is higher.
Additional cost of the plot, if applicable, shall be charged as per society policy for corner plots, boulevard-facing plots, or park-facing plots.
All taxes, bank charges, FED, and any other government fees shall be payable by the allottee.

div.p: All subsequent dues, installments, possession charges, or escalation charges, if any, shall be payable by the transferee. The society reserves the right to change the plot location or number in the interest of the society or as directed by CDA.
